question: What Are the Types of PID Controller?
body_html:
PID controller types are the three equation forms used by industrial controllers: parallel, ideal and series. The same tuning values give different results in each form, so you must know which one your controller uses.

TypeHow gain Kp actsTuning effect
ParallelKp acts only on the P termP, I and D tuned independently
Ideal (ISA)Kp multiplies P, I and DOne Kp change scales all three actions
SeriesKp applies to all, and I and D interactChanging one setting shifts the others
